title: UCC Challenges
html:
Udaipur Cycling Club “Milestone Awards 2024”: Celebrating the Achievements of our Cyclists

Cycling is not just a sport, it’s a passion. And in Udaipur, we take this passion to the next level. Every year, we gather to celebrate the incredible achievements of our cyclists in the Udaipur Cycling Milestone Awards.

This year, we have set some awe-inspiring milestones for our cyclists to conquer. These include cycling a distance of 5,000 KM, conquering 25,000 meters of elevation, completing 18 or more centuries, and riding for a minimum of 150 days. We are excited to see our cyclists push themselves to reach these milestones and celebrate their successes at the end of the year.

The Udaipur Cycling Club Milestone Awards 2024 will be held at our annual dinner meet. It will be an evening filled with celebration, recognition, and inspiration. We invite all cyclists in Udaipur to join us and share their passion for cycling.

Let’s come together to celebrate the achievements of our cyclists and inspire each other to push the limits of what we thought was possible!

Monthly Challenge:

Male Members:

  • DISTANCE: 600 KM
  • ELEVATION: 5,000 Meters
  • RIDING DAYS: 25 Days
  • 100+ KM RIDES: 4 Rides
  • SUNDAY Group Ride Count: 4 Rides

Female/60+ Senior Citizens/Kids Under 15:

  • DISTANCE: 300 KM
  • ELEVATION: 2,000 Meters
  • RIDING DAYS: 20 Days
  • 100+ KM RIDES: 2 Rides
  • SUNDAY Group Ride Count: 2 Rides

Annual Challenge:

Male Members:

  • DISTANCE: 5,000 KM
  • ELEVATION: 25,000 Meters
  • RIDING DAYS: 150 Days
  • 100+ KM RIDES: 18 Rides
  • SUNDAY Group Ride Count: 24 Rides

Female/60+ Senior Citizens/Kids Under 15:

  • DISTANCE: 2,500 KM
  • ELEVATION: 12,000 Meters
  • RIDING DAYS: 100 Days
  • 100+ KM RIDES: 8 Rides
  • SUNDAY Group Ride Count: 20 Rides

UCC Super Rider:

Cyclist member who successfully complete distances of 100, 200, 300, 400, and 500 kilometers within the calendar year (January to December) will be recognized and honored with a special medal known as the “UCC Super Rider.“

Rules and Guidelines will be shared soon!

The member needs to provide proof and photos to obtain this title. After verification, we will announce the name in the group.
